checks: R=(2−x)/3 gives the first cap fraction R². Reflection fixes the source and exchanges the other caps. The below-both-base-vertices case uses two edge fractions and gives at least 2(1−R)/(2−R)>16/33, including the incidence tie.
In the remaining branch the horizontal threshold is strictly between the base vertices, and the upper tip fraction is exactly (L+3−3R)²/[2L(L+3)].

When z≥R², the minimum of R²+5z/4 over all real R is the displayed rational function of L and exceeds 1 for 0<L≤8/5. When z≤R², direct differentiation gives monotone decrease in both variables on the enlarged rectangle.
Exact fraction checks give 128/279<(17/25)², 16/33>128/279 and the rectangle-corner profile 57847/57500>1. The constants and both cases agree with 3f10007d0abab8f7 §2.

overlap.comparison: Its ordinary cap/profile counterexample uses a thicker triangle; it does not give the threshold L>8/5 for this reflection-fixed parametrized family.
